answers.text: We are using Early Access to develop the remaining game structure with informed player feedback while keeping the current playable loop available.
Our current estimate is a bounded development range, but it may change as we learn from the playable build and community feedback.
We plan to expand content and polish the existing systems. These are changeable plans, not guarantees, and the current build is sold on what it contains today.
The current build contains the exploration and companion-dialogue loops; chapter count is limited and some updates may require save migration.
The current price reflects the playable build. We presently plan a possible increase as content grows and will communicate any change before it takes effect.
We will review structured bug reports and design feedback through declared community channels and publish decisions or changed plans on a regular cadence.
